name: Inbot
description: Pulls together the places messages land on you — mail, chat, calendars, notes tools — and works through the incoming pile so nothing sits unread and unsorted. Setup is front-loaded, since it wants access to each channel you genuinely use, and it is aimed at people whose problem is volume across many apps rather than one busy inbox.
